mentions.name: dockerlings
mentions.description: A terminal user interface (TUI) for learning Docker, inspired by rustlings, that provides interactive Docker exercises, with plans to extend it with more advanced exercise paths.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on https://github.com/furkan/dockerlings, a TUI for learning docker (name and concept inspired by rustlings). It has attracted a surprising but welcome amount of interest, and I'm looking into extending it with more advanced exercise paths.
